annotation.bound_parties_text: The non-binding resolution only calls on the VP/HR, the Member States, the Council and the European Council to adopt a common position and work towards negotiations, and imposes no binding obligations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: Calls on the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy (VP/HR), the Member States and the European Council to develop and adopt
